subject: [PATCH 7/9] mm/gup: walk multiple PTEs per follow_page_pte() call

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the __get_user_pages() function by walking multiple PTEs per follow_page_pte() call, reducing the number of restarts and lock acquisitions. The patch achieves this by computing the walk end from the inclusive end address, rather than using pmd_addr_end(), which can lead to unsigned-long overflow on 2-level page tables. Additionally, it defers resolving none PTEs in hugetlbfs VMAs until after unlocking. A failure on the first PTE is returned to the caller, while subsequent failures are treated as short reads and retried by __get_user_pages(). The patch modifies the follow_page_pte() function to walk multiple PTEs and commit every page found.
